limits: Source-literal and three explicitly enumerated local policies, not a full Rust cfg/call graph; tests may appear in lexical sites.
Pillow/wave/FreeType read checks are distinct from Bevy/native rendering, audio listening and historical semantics. WGSL text is not compiled.
Icon pixel differences are observations; neither corruption nor need to replace current assets inferred.
Remaining nonliteral callers,alternate IDs and generic filesystem loads keep complete dynamic closure open.
All15 nonliteral sites from the previous assets.load spelling census now have a bounded current-source policy; this is not exhaustive Rust method/cfg/call analysis.
Arbitrary fallback names,other method receiver spellings,generated choices,library/extension behavior and execution gates remain open.
DDS base image decoded with Pillow only; GPU mip/sampler/native shader and image fidelity not established.
All33 compared icon PNGs match native DDS dimensions; RGBA differences at most1/255 per channel; rounding is a hypothesis,not an established cause.
